topPRs.title: feat: storage provider abstraction
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## What's changed

Added a storage abstraction layer to decouple from AWS, enabling local development without AWS dependencies.

## Key features

- **Local development**: Works with filesystem storage (`.local-storage/`)
- **AWS production**: Seamless AWS Secrets Manager & SSM integration
- **Auto-detection**: Automatically chooses provider based on `STORAGE_PROVIDER` env var
- **Same API**: No business logic changes needed

## Architecture

```
Application → Interfaces (ISecretStore, IParameterStore) → Adapters (AWS/Local) → Storage
```

## Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
# Add: STORAGE_PROVIDER=local
bun dev
```

## Files added

- `src/interfaces/storage/` - Abstract interfaces
- `src/adapters/storage/` - AWS & Local implementations
- `src/factories/StorageFactory.ts` - Provider factory

## Files migrated

All `src/actions/*` files now use `StorageFactory` instead of direct AWS services.

## Other changes

- Changed default port from 3000 to 3100
- Added `.local-storage/` to `.gitignore`
- Updated README with setup instructions

topPRs.author: Neysixx
topPRs.body:
This pull request standardizes the usage of brand colors across the app by replacing hardcoded hex color values with CSS variables for Sendo brand colors. It introduces a new `sendo-dark-red` color and updates all relevant gradient backgrounds and UI elements to use these semantic variables, improving maintainability and consistency. Minor improvements to font-family declarations and formatting are also included.

**Brand color standardization and updates:**

* Added a new CSS variable `--sendo-dark-red` and updated `--sendo-orange` to match the brand palette in `globals.css`. All gradients now use `from-sendo-orange`, `via-sendo-red`, and `to-sendo-dark-red` instead of hardcoded hex values. topPRs.author: Neysixx

This pull request refactors the storage-related codebase to standardize naming conventions, improve type safety, and modernize the factory implementation. The most important changes include renaming files and interfaces for consistency, updating import paths throughout the codebase, and refactoring the `StorageFactory` class into a constant object with arrow functions.

**Refactoring and modernization of storage factory:**

* Refactored `StorageFactory` from a class to a constant object with arrow functions, updating all method definitions and usages accordingly in `src/factories/storage-factory.ts`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L30-R35) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L57-R63) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L75-R81) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L93-R116)

**File and interface renaming for consistency:**

* Renamed adapter and factory files to use kebab-case and updated corresponding import paths across the codebase (e.g., `AWSSecretStoreAdapter.ts` → `aws-secret-store.adapter.ts`, `StorageFactory.ts` → `storage-factory.ts`). [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L15-R20) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-09ea11d778de38d05626e874eefea6e384a42aeaaa029e7fd40816dfdc4ded1fL6-R6) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-e8b8a291e7283ebb96a1f61782c33ab1ffdf838a1ac23bae034ce889c4dcfb88L6-R6) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-54dc3dce6273f8cb849a7b610db6f86ac78eb0e8312fb709258ec63b2b062f2cL9-R9) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-780927099f9814f65ae09ab4b95c25969d713c42a0c329197843e689f9a350b8L9-R9)
* Renamed interface files for clarity (`ISecretStore` → `siecret-store`, `IParameterStore` → `iparameter-store`) and updated all related imports. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L15-R20) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-09ea11d778de38d05626e874eefea6e384a42aeaaa029e7fd40816dfdc4ded1fL6-R6) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-e8b8a291e7283ebb96a1f61782c33ab1ffdf838a1ac23bae034ce889c4dcfb88L6-R6) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-54dc3dce6273f8cb849a7b610db6f86ac78eb0e8312fb709258ec63b2b062f2cL9-R9) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-780927099f9814f65ae09ab4b95c25969d713c42a0c329197843e689f9a350b8L9-R9) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-47bec096c42c7764017b89295992034df7235b8ce6eec06342fb7344df816440L2-R2)

**Type safety and import improvements:**

* Updated imports to use `type` where appropriate for improved type safety and faster compilation. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-ca98f4bca8d8a842e0e584317fabce632465a8fba76d985c5abf0f1c730fa6a9L15-R20) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-09ea11d778de38d05626e874eefea6e384a42aeaaa029e7fd40816dfdc4ded1fL6-R6) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-e8b8a291e7283ebb96a1f61782c33ab1ffdf838a1ac23bae034ce889c4dcfb88L6-R6) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-54dc3dce6273f8cb849a7b610db6f86ac78eb0e8312fb709258ec63b2b062f2cL9-R9) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-780927099f9814f65ae09ab4b95c25969d713c42a0c329197843e689f9a350b8L9-R9) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-47bec096c42c7764017b89295992034df7235b8ce6eec06342fb7344df816440L2-R2)
* Changed return type of `getAnalyzerTrades` to allow `null` when the analyzer is not configured, instead of returning an empty response object.

**General codebase consistency:**

* Updated all usages of `StorageFactory` in action files to use the new import path and naming convention.
